settings.contacts.label: Contacts
settings.contacts.description: Map of person names to the sound played when a notification mentions them. Key: the exact name. Value: absolute path to a .ogg or .mp3 file.
settings.match_case_sensitive.label: Case sensitive matching

settings.only_apps.label: Only these apps
settings.only_apps.description: Optional list of notification app names to restrict matching to. Leave empty to match notifications from any app.

settings.show_widget.label: Show bar icon
settings.show_widget.description: When off, the bell icon is hidden from the bar.
